page.title: Hollowbrook Bakery - This Week's Menu
page.text:
Hollowbrook Bakery
baked every morning, gone by noon
| Sourdough Loaf 48 hour ferment, crackly crust | $9
| Half loaf $5 |
| Want it sliced? +$1 |
| Seeded Rye caraway, sunflower, a little honey | ~~$8~~ $7
| Butter Croissant laminated by hand | $4 SOLD OUT
| Cinnamon Morning Bun orange zest, lots of sugar | $4.50
| Olive Focaccia* by the slab, serves four | ask
* Olive Focaccia is $11 a slab this season.
Local delivery only, flat $6 per order. Order by text before 8pm for the next morning and we'll send an invoice.
Hollowbrook Bakery is a fictional bakery made for a demo.

shipping.notes: Local delivery only, flat $6 per order.

extraction_notes: Seeded Rye has a crossed-out $8 price, so the current price $7 was used.
Butter Croissant is marked SOLD OUT, so it is kept with available set to false.
Olive Focaccia is listed as 'ask' in the menu, but a footnote gives $11 a slab, so that price was used.
Half loaf ($5) is a variant of Sourdough Loaf, and the base $9 is the whole loaf price.
Slicing (+$1) is listed under Sourdough Loaf, so it was added only as an add-on to that item.
Orders are by text with an invoice sent; this does not change the prices or shipping.
